title: Third-party scorer module must match the allow-list exactly, never by package prefix
answers: third-party scorer loads code from an uploaded run artifact
registered scorer from a file:// artifact root executes arbitrary Python on the server
scorer deserialization imports a submodule under mlflow.genai.scorers.trulens or ragas
body:
Symptom: a registered trulens/ragas/deepeval/phoenix scorer loads a file a caller placed on the server (e.g. a run artifact under a file:// experiment root), and that file's top-level code runs before any class check.
Root cause: mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate accepted an allow-listed package or any dotted descendant (module_path.startswith(m + ".")), and passed the descendant straight to importlib.import_module.
Fix pattern: membership check against the frozenset in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES (module_path not in ...), done before any import_module call.
Constraints: the allow-list holds only modules that define supported Scorer classes (package roots plus their scorers submodules). A new scorer module must be added explicitly; prefix matching must not be reintroduced.
applies: Any change to third-party scorer deserialization or the allow-list in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py and scorer_utils.py.
says: Registering an evaluation judge executes untrusted code from an uploaded artifact file on the server.
Prevent registered evaluation scorers from loading and executing unauthorized files stored on the server.
Loading an evaluation metric module allows arbitrary script execution from uploaded experiment files.
Restrict registered evaluation metrics to an exact approved list rather than allowing subpackages.
search: Third-party scorer deserialization must match module paths exactly against an allow-list rather than allowing prefix or descendant matching. In mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate, module paths must be checked for membership in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES before calling importlib.import_module. This prevents scorers from loading files placed on the server, such as run artifacts under file:// experiment roots, and executing top-level code. Applies to third-party scorer deserialization changes; new scorer modules must be added explicitly and prefix matching must not be reintroduced.
